description: Efficiency of dynamic traffic signal control in work zones with shuttle operation: theory and practice - data and models is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Igor Mikolasek (Transport Research Centre). This dataset contains Excel sheets with relevant models and calculations as well as case study data for a paper "Efficiency of dynamic traffic signal controlin work zones with shuttle operation: theory and practice" published in European Transport Research Review. Files Ludgeřovice period 1-3 contain case study raw data and it's processing (incl. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
